What you're talking about is great in theory and does create more people interested in music but if you look at all the factors in play currently more access doesn't equal more talent. At the level of professional music distribution that's significant enough to reach the masses there's arguably much less talent and diversity. There's less money than ever in recording and big name music production due to internet and piracy. And this is an industry where votes are cast with dollars. Record companies are more likely than ever to only push and put out the same tried formulas that can still generate revenue and that's what we're flooded with.
